title: Bilateral Remittance Matrix (new)
values: Published 2021 top bilateral remittance corridor estimates: United States-Mexico $52bn; United Arab Emirates-India $20bn; Saudi Arabia-India $13bn; United States-India $6bn.
coordinate_method: Country-capital coordinates are representative anchors supplied by the test fixture. They are not financial infrastructure locations.
caveat: World Bank describes these as estimates allocated from migrant-stock and income assumptions. Map arcs encode bilateral relationships and do not trace money-transfer infrastructure.
